canonical.project_name: 巴林Al Dur 2海水淡化及发电项目
canonical.project_name_en: Bahrain Al Dur 2 Independent Water and Power Project

articles.author: ACWA Power
articles.content:
近日，沙特国际电力和水务公司（以下简称“ACWA
Power”）为巴林Al Dur 2 独立海水淡化及发电厂项目完成5.8亿美元的再融资。
该项目总装机容量为1.5GW，使用海水淡化反渗透膜法（SWRO）技术，每天生产22.7万立方米的淡化水。
ACWA Power致力于以负担得起的成本，为数百万人提供清洁的电力和水资源，支持巴林基础设施的可持续发展战略，为当地的经济和社会发展做出贡献。
该项目包括阿拉伯国家银行、渣打银行等在内的多家融资机构参与，ACWA Power担任再融资的唯一财务顾问。
Al-Dur 2项目于2019年7月完成融资关闭，由沙特本国银行、地区性银行和国际性银行提供总金额为10.5亿美元的项目贷款。
2020年，公司完成了约3.7亿美元的再融资，引入夹层贷款，这是整个海合会地区、中东和北非地区项目融资史上，在建设期内的首次再融资。该项目于2022年6月投入商业运营。
articles.title: ACWA Power完成巴林海淡项目5.8亿美元再融资

articles.author: ACWA Power
articles.content:
Haya Power & Desalination Company has started full operations of Bahrain’s Al-Dur 2 independent water and power project(IWPP) project.
Bahrain’s Electricity and Water Affairs (EWA) Ministry selected a team led by ACWA Power to develop the contract in 2018.
The power generation plant is equipped with combined-cycle gas turbines and has a design capacity of 1,500MW.
The desalination plant utilises seawater reverse osmosis technology and can treat up to 227,000 cm/d.
The project company comprises ACWA Power, which maintains a 60 per cent share, Japan’s Mitsui with a 30 per cent holding and the local Almoayyed Contracting Group with a 10 per cent stake.
A consortium of China’s Sepco 3, Power China and France’s Sidem is the project’s EPCcontractor, while ACWA Power subsidiary Nomac is the operation and maintenance contractor.
The build, own and operate contract is supported by a 20-year power and water purchase agreement between the project company and EWA.

event.project_summary: ACWA Power has completed a $580 million refinancing for the Al Dur 2 Independent Water and Power Project in Bahrain. The project has a capacity of 1.5 GW and produces 227,000 cubic meters of desalinated water daily. The refinancing involved multiple financial institutions, and the project entered commercial operation in June 2022.
